2. The plaintiff filed a suit for declaration of title of the suit land and according to the plaintiff, the suit land was purchased by plaintiff No.1 and one Sokiruddin by a sale deed dated 7.12.55 from its owner and in S.A. operation, the land was recorded in their names to the extent of .22 decimals of land instead of .26 decimals of land and Sokiruddin transferred .13 decimals of land to plaintiff Nos.2 and 3 by a sale deed dated 5.12.78 who sold away 3.75 decimals of land to plaintiff No.4 by a deed dated 23.1.96 and the plaintiffs were possessing .26 decimals of land from the middle of the suit dag by excluding .34 decimals of land from its northern side but in R.S. operation, the land was recorded in their names in R.S. Plot No.2274 but not in the northern side of the previous plot. The plaintiff by way of amendment of the plaint, stated that the ex—landlord of the suit land was Tarash Estate who evicted its tenants and gave .32 decimals of land by Patton which was demarcated by the surveyor of Tarash Acquired Estate and there was a suit being O.C. Suit No.25 of 1954 for recovery of khas possession in which Abdul Mannan got a decree from the Court. 

 3. The defendant Government contested the suit by filing written statement denying the material allegations made in the plaint stating that the suit land was the excess khas land of the ex landlords as bazaar and vested with the Government and after the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act came into being, the suit land is within the periphery of Dhulauri hat and the plaintiffs by creating some forged documents, filed the present suit. 

 4. Defendant Nos.3 and 4 filed another written statement stating that .24 decimals of land of the suit jote belonged to Abdullah who transferred it to Abdul Mannan and Abdullah transferred .12 decimals of land being guardian of his minor son Abdul Mannan to defendant Nos.3 and 4 by a deed dated 17.12.57 and Abdullah transferred .22 decimals of land to these defendants by another deed dated 15.11.67 and they are possessing the said land.
